content: Tetexi kememɨte'ukayatsaxɨ
Kepauka yunaitɨ memanukɨ Kurutani hatɨayaritsie Yawé Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Tamamata heimana huta nuiwaritsie yuxexuime xekeniwaranuyexeiya,
mɨpaɨ ketiniwaruta'aitɨa, memititɨkɨkɨ ha'ute tamamata heimana huta haa hixɨapa mieme, hakewa yemekɨ memeti'ukai mawari wewiwamete. Mɨpaɨ xeketeniwarutahɨawi hakewa memetiheni mana mepitiyatsa».
Hikɨ Kutsuhexi kaniwarukuxeɨrieni tamamata heimana huta nuiwaritsie memanayexeiyarie,
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Xekenehu haa hixɨapa Yawé kakunieya mayekatsie yuxexuitɨ tetexi xekenatɨki. Tamamata heimana huta kanayeimɨkɨ, xexuime 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama kememɨyupaɨme.
Pɨ'inɨaritɨni xehetsiemieme. 'Uxa'atɨniwarie xeniwema mepɨxeta'iwawiya: “¿Titayari 'ena 'ikɨ tetexi tititei?”,

xeme mɨpaɨ xepɨtewatahɨawe: “Kepauka Kurutanitsie makweiyatɨya tɨratu kakuniyari Yawé hetsiemieme. Haa kananutayepiere hixɨapa, 'ikɨ tetexi mɨyamɨretei tame 'ixaheritsixi pɨta'inɨari mɨya mɨtiuyɨtsie mieme”».
'Ixaheritsixi yamekateniuyurieni Kutsuhexi kemɨtiwarutahɨawixɨ Yawé kemainekai. Tetexi mekaniutitɨkɨ Kurutani hixɨapa mieme, kememɨyupaɨmekai nuiwarite, mematihenitsie mekaneitɨkɨ mana mekanitiyatsa.

Meta Kutsuhexi hakewa mawari wewiwamete memeti'ukai, Kurutani hatɨayari hixɨapa tɨratu kakuniyari memukweiximekai manata tetexi kanitiyatsa tawarita tamamata heimana hutame. Hikɨ 'akuxi mana kanehekɨaka tetexi.

Mawari wewiwamete haa hixɨapa mekaniye'ukaitɨni kakuni memakwekai naime 'aixɨa mete'uyuriekake Yawé Kutsuhexi kemɨrahɨawekai. Mɨpaɨ katiniɨyɨni Muitsexi Kutsuhexi kemɨrahɨawekai. Teɨteri meyumexɨitɨatɨ mekananukɨne.
Yunaitɨ yamete'uyurieku, Yawé kakunieya meta mawari wewiwamete mekananukɨne teɨteri wahɨxie.
Mɨkɨ 'ixaheritsixi wahamatɨa mekanaye'ukaitɨni kuyaxi Xuweni nuiwarimama, Kahari nuiwarimama, Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨata me'atɨ, Muitsexi kemɨtiu'aitakai.
Huta tewiyari miriyari (40.000) kuyaxi mekaniuyuka'uitɨani Yawé hɨxie, makuweritsie me'eerietɨ Keriku hepatsie meyutakwinike.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Yawé Kutsuhexi mariweme kanayeitɨani 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie. Teɨteri Kutsuhexi 'aixɨa mekatenixeiyakaitɨni kemɨreuterixɨ 'uyeikatɨ, Muitsexi kememɨtexeiyakai hepaɨ.
Hikɨ Yawé Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Mɨpaɨ ketiniwaruta'aitɨa tɨratu kakuniyari tɨkɨmete meke'anatikɨne Kurutanitsie».
Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe mawari wewiwamete memanatikɨnekɨ,
mɨkɨ mekananatikɨne tɨratu kakuniyari me'akwetɨ. Kepauka wakikɨa memɨti'ui, haa kananuyeyeurieni, 'uhanetɨ kanayani hutarieka.
Mexɨakame metseritsie tamamata tukaritsie, 'ixaheritsixi mekananukɨne Kurutanitsie Kirikari rakutewakaku mekanikuyaxe, Keriku tau manatineikatsie 'aurie.
Hikɨ mana Kutsuhexi katiniwaruta'aitɨani mana tetexi memɨtiyatsakɨ Kurutani haa hixɨapa mematitɨkixɨ 'ayewakikaku,
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «'Uxa'atɨni warie, xɨka xeniwema mexe'uta'iwawiya: “¿Titayari 'ikɨ tetexi 'ena tititei?”,
xeme mɨpaɨ xepɨtewatahɨawe: “Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memanakɨ Kurutanitsie wakikɨa mepakɨ”.
Yawé xekakaɨyari, yaxeikɨa pɨtiuyuri Haramara Mɨxeta hetsie kemɨtiuyuri wakikɨa pɨwarawitɨtɨya.
'Ikɨ mɨyapɨtiuyɨ yunaitɨ nuiwarite memɨtehetimanikɨ Yawé mɨmariwe, xeme xemitsutɨanikɨ xeheyemakatɨ yuheyemekɨ xemeyexeiyanikɨ».
